blind.description: An ornate French salon/Louis XVI style side chair. It features a round upholstered seat covered in dark green fabric with gold star or floral motifs, a matching oval medallion backrest topped with an ornamental gilded bow crest, and four fluted, tapered legs with gilded square plinths and feet. The wooden frame is painted off-white/cream with gilded accents. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or holes, resting flat and stably on its four feet.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a circular green upholstered cushion with gold dot/star motifs, with the carved oval backrest and bow crest visible behind it, casting a detailed shadow to the top-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 feet tall), with a seat diameter of roughly 1.5 to 1.8 feet.
